length.text: About 1.4 to 1.6 m; record about 2.5 m

overview.text: The Caspian Whipsnake is a fast, non-venomous snake of the Balkans and eastern Europe - perhaps the longest snake in Europe.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually 140 to 160 cm long; a few exceed 2 m, and the record was about 2.5 m.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: The Balkans (Albania, Greece, Bulgaria, North Macedonia, Serbia, Croatia, Montenegro, Romania, southern Hungary), Turkey, Moldova, southern Ukraine and Russia, Kazakhstan, Georgia and Iran.

habitat.text: Grassy, open areas with scattered bushes.

diet.text: A generalist predator of many kinds of vertebrates.
